- **D8-epic-grill-layer-unproven** · `D8` · _open_ — RE-SCOPED 2026-08-16 against artifacts, not assumptions. The row claimed the whole 2026-07-30 wave was unproven; half of it is DONE: product-owner + the PRD contract have real runs (design/262-public-account-deletion-page.md, 248-, 247- on the bound project) and grill mode has driven live form sequences. The xeno-epic TOOL is the unproven half — and NOT because the gh path is broken: all 10 epic-labelled issues on the project are hand-rolled (no `Open decisions` / `Not yet specified` sections) and design/epics/ never existed, i.e. the tool was never REACHABLE. Root cause found + fixed same day: nothing routed to it. The expo orchestrator (the installed pack) never mentioned epic at all, the CORE spine did not either, and product-owner held mcp**ui**epic in tools: + xeno-epic in skills: while its PROMPT never said when to use them — listed in frontmatter is an index entry, not a behaviour (same failure mode as the caveman rule, second time this class has bitten). Routing now lives in the CORE spine so every domain inherits it, with one-line pointers in both packs and a `when the brief is bigger than one slice` section in product-owner. STILL OPEN: a real /epic run. The pilot now tests something reachable — and the sharper question it answers is D9-shaped: does the tool EARN its place when hand-rolled epic issues are demonstrably working?
  - _pattern:_ a capability is reachable only when some layer ROUTES to it — frontmatter grants the tool, the prompt has to say when to reach for it.

RETRACTION: the 0.97% marker figure this row previously cited was NOT evidence — caveman-reminder.sh:41-44 documents that PreToolUse fires mid-turn on a bare tool_use with no text, so the scorer logged marker:false forever regardless of compliance.
